brief.prompt: A woman with medium-deep skin and dark curly hair pulled back stands at a bathroom mirror beside a bright window, wearing soft peach blush placed high on her cheekbones and well-defined natural brows. A few makeup brushes rest in a cup on the vanity, and the scene is calm, warm and evenly lit.
brief.alt: Woman checking her blush placement in a mirror in daylight, showing makeup for face shape
brief.purpose: Introduces the core idea that placement is judged in the mirror under good light, not chosen from a chart.

review.alt: Woman with dark curly hair pulled back touches her cheek while checking her makeup in a bathroom mirror beside a bright window, with soft peach blush on her cheekbones and makeup brushes in a marble cup on the vanity.
